title: Studio Blackburn Gives Ellis Butchers a Cast of Characters From Meat

value.alt: Ellis Butchers identity by Studio Blackburn

value.text: No livestock silhouettes. No cut charts. Studio Blackburn ripped up the butcher-branding rulebook for Ellis Butchers.
Instead of humanising the animal, they humanised the meat, giving cuts of meat their own legs, led by a mascot called Meat Ellis, a cast of characters wholesome, unexpected and genuinely fun.
Two shops, one parent brand, two distinct personalities. Proof that identity systems can flex by neighbourhood without losing coherence.
